agent_checkable.metric: Approved swaps asked less than 24 hours before kick-off
agent_checkable.check: A script compares each approved swap's time with kick-off (Q02).
cites: [S:S03 §2 "Swaps must be asked for at least 24 hours before kick-off."]

cites: [A:A01 "No match starts short of stewards all season."]

steps: A steward posts a swap request in the group chat.
The coordinator checks the handbook and the rota.
The coordinator updates the rota sheet.
problems: Last season three matches started one steward short.
Swaps asked too late were approved by mistake.

in: A checked list of swaps out.
Approved swaps written to the rota sheet.

inputs.description: One week's swap request messages, about 10 a week.
inputs.format: plain text, one swap per message
constraints: The steward giving up a shift

samples.description: A made-up week of swap requests.

glossary.meaning: One steward position at one match.
cites: [A:A01 "Shift: one steward position at one match."]

glossary.meaning: The published start time of the match.
cites: [A:A01 "Kick-off: the published start time of the match."]

acceptance_tests.words: When I give it a week of swap requests, every late swap is refused and no match is left short.
cites: [A:A01 "When I give it a week of swap requests, every late swap is refused and no match is left short."]

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
ranks.use_for: Swap rules, steward numbers, request format

ranks.what: Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: A stored source of rank 2 or better with a word-for-word quote.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; never enough for a decision on its own.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area; newer beats older within a rank only when the newer source covers the point.

The two handbooks disagree on the swap notice period: 48 hours in the 2098 handbook (S02), 24 hours in the 2099 handbook (S03). Both are rank 2; the 2099 handbook covers the 2099 season and is followed.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.
cites: [S:S02 §2 "Swaps must be asked for at least 48 hours before kick-off."]
[S:S03 §2 "Swaps must be asked for at least 24 hours before kick-off."]

output.description: One row per swap request, approved or refused. A request that names no steward taking the shift is refused.

fields.name: giving_up
fields.description: The steward giving up the shift.

cites: [A:A01 "A request that names no steward taking the shift is refused."]

rules.statement: A swap asked less than 24 hours before kick-off is refused.
